# Contributing to [Project Name]

Thank you for your interest in contributing to our project! We appreciate your help in building and maintaining a high-quality codebase and an inclusive community.

## How to Contribute

1. **Reporting Issues:**  
   - Use our issue tracker to report bugs or suggest enhancements.  
   - Provide clear, concise descriptions and steps to reproduce issues.

2. **Proposing Changes:**  
   - Fork the repository and create a new branch for your changes.  
   - Ensure your changes follow our coding standards and include relevant tests.  
   - Submit a pull request (PR) with a detailed explanation of your changes.

3. **Review Process:**  
   - All contributions will be reviewed by our maintainers.  
   - Please be open to feedback and make any requested changes to your PR.

## Guidelines

- **Code Style:**  
  Follow the code style guidelines as defined in the project documentation. Consistency is key!
  
- **Commit Messages:**  
  Write clear, descriptive commit messages that explain the intent of your changes.
  
- **Documentation:**  
  Update relevant documentation to reflect your changes or additions.

## Code of Conduct

All contributors are expected to follow our [Code of Conduct](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). This ensures that our community remains welcoming, respectful, and productive.

## Communication

If you have any questions or need further guidance:
- Check the project’s documentation.
- Reach out to the maintainers via [info@makemonmouth.co.uk] (info@makemonmouth.co.uk).
- Join our community discussions if available.

Thank you for helping us maintain and improve this project!
